31700-XII.s: This bill fixes the 2009 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII), setting out expenditure, commitments and receipts by policy and non-policy article, in thousands of euros. It also adopts the budget statements for the baten-lastendiensten KNMI, Rijkswaterstaat and Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) for the year 2009 accompanying this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Verkeer en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31792-IV.s: The bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement for Kingdom Relations (the autumn budget adjustment), changing the appropriations for the rule of law function and for strengthening the autonomy of Kingdom partners. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force at 1 December 2008 with retroactive effect where publication is later.

31792-VI.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice (Najaarsnota supplementary budget), setting out expenditure and revenue changes across policy and non-policy articles. It does not itself create new powers or delegate rule-making; the explanatory memorandum explains budget shortfalls and surpluses in areas such as fines and transactions and legal aid.
q: Original budget, first supplementary budget, second supplementary budget changes and resulting totals for each policy article.
Stand vastgestelde begroting Stand 1ste suppletoire begroting Mutaties 2de suppletoire begroting Stand 2de suppletoire begroting

31924-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement for the National Debt (IXA) through a supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts for the financing of the state debt and cash management. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 1 June 2008 of the current budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32123-XII.s: This bill establishes the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (Verkeer en Waterstaat), including the budget for the baten-lastendiensten KNMI, Rijkswaterstaat and Inspectie VenW. The explanatory memorandum excerpts describe policy programmes in aviation, road and rail safety, public transport experiments and inspection, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) for the year 2010 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Verkeer en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32222-XII.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) in connection with the autumn budget review, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) for the year 2009
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Verkeer en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2009

32395-IV.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of Koninkrijksrelaties (IV), adjusting spending and commitments for articles on the Waarborgfunctie and the autonomy of Kingdom partners, following the Voorjaarsnota. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and makes it effective from 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Koninkrijksrelaties (IV), voor het jaar 2010

32395-VI.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice (article VI) following the spring memorandum, changing expenditure and revenue figures across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 June of the budget year, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice (VI) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32609-XI.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment (VROM) by transferring its entire expenditure and receipts to other ministries under an incidental supplementary budget, with the budget managed by the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment. It also waives the annual report and closing balance for that budget year, so the 2011 spending is not separately accounted for.
32609-XI.j: The memorandum justifies the waiver by stating that no financial annual statements of VROM will be produced for 2011 because the budget is transferred to other ministries, while the Algemene Rekenkamer and auditors can still check the transfer of balance items.
q: For the year 2011 therefore no accountability takes place on the basis of VROM's financial annual statements.
Over het jaar 2011 vindt er dus geen verantwoording plaats aan de hand van financiële jaarstukken van VROM.
p: Article 4(3) waives the annual report and closing balance normally required under the Comptabiliteitswet for the 2011 budget, reducing the accountability information available to parliament and auditors for that year.

32710-VII.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement for its business-operations services, via a supplementary budget and final adjustment (slotwet). It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2010 is amended
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd

33480-IXB.s: The bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by means of a supplementary budget (Najaarsnota), setting the amounts in thousands of euros and taking effect from 1 December 2012. It also temporarily allows the annual reports for 2012 to omit certain accounting requirements of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, pending the adoption of the new 'Verantwoord Begroten' presentation.
33480-IXB.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary deviation in article 3 by the introduction of the new budget presentation 'Verantwoord Begroten', which departments already partly applied in the 2012 budget.
q: This deviation concerns a temporary provision, which is necessary because the departments, with the consent of the Minister of Finance, have already partly prepared the 2012 budget in line with Verantwoord Begroten.

Deze afwijking betreft een tijdelijke voorziening, die noodzakelijk is, omdat de departementen met instemming van de Minister van Financiën de begroting 2012 voor een deel al conform Verantwoord Begroten hebben opgesteld.

34000-XV.s: This bill fixes the 2015 departmental expenditure and receipts budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and of the SZW Agency, in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2015. The attached explanatory memorandum extract covers budget policy on labour market, benefits, childcare, pensions and integration, and mentions delegation and oversight only in passing.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2015 belonging to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34085-IX.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget (state budget) of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and of the National Debt (IXA) by means of a second supplementary budget tied to the Najaarsnota. The explanatory memorandum covers the financial markets policy article, mainly reallocating budget items such as a large negative adjustment for the bank loan guarantee scheme.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Finance for the year 2014
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Financiën, voor het jaar 2014

34775-III.s: This bill fixes the 2018 budget appropriations for the Ministry of General Affairs (including agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie), the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD). The explanatory memorandum notes the new Intelligence and Security Services Act, which creates the Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden (TIB) and funds it within the Ministry's budget.
q: This law also adapts the independent oversight of the security services, for which the Prime Minister is responsible.
Ook wordt met deze wet het onafhankelijk toezicht op de veiligheidsdiensten, waarvoor de Minister-President verantwoordelijk is, hierop aangepast.

34960-IV.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statements (first supplementary budget) for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES Fund (H), shifting amounts among policy articles for Sint Maarten and Caribbean reconstruction, police and judicial capacity. It fixes the budget in thousands of euros and sets entry into force as 1 June 2018 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the budget statement of the BES Fund (H), both for the year 2018;

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H), alle voor het jaar 2018;

34960-VI.s: This first supplementary budget bill for the Ministry of Justice and Security for 2018 amends the departmental budget statement, raising total commitments and expenditure by modest amounts across police, justice, security, prisons, counterterrorism and migration articles. It also adjusts the budgets of several executive agencies (DJI, IND, CJIB, NFI, JUSTIS), with the bill taking effect from 1 June 2018 and applying retroactively where publication falls later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security (VI) for 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35095-IV.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statements (second supplementary budget) for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds, adjusting spending and receipts across policy articles, mainly for reconstruction and emergency aid on the Caribbean islands. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2018 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds for the year 2018.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en het BES-fonds voor het jaar 2018.

35095-VI.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the 2018 budget statements for its executive agencies (DJI, IND, CJIB, NFI, JUSTIS), mainly reallocating appropriations and revenue within the ministry. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and of the budget statement for the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2018
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2018

35210-XII.s: This is the first supplementary budget bill (eerste suppletoire begroting) for 2019 of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, amending the departmental budget and the agency budgets (Rijkswaterstaat, ILT, KNMI). It shifts money between policy articles, including a €10 million increase for the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport and a €1 million transfer to LNV for the Ctgb.
q: Funds are added to the IenW budget for the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) to address urgent bottlenecks and implement the risk-based approach.
Op de IenW-begroting worden middelen toegevoegd voor de Inspectie voor Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) om urgente knelpunten aan te pakken en invulling te geven aan de risicogerichte aanpak.

35300-XII.s: The bill establishes the 2020 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) and the budget statements for its agencies, in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum sets out policy priorities, budget tables and multi-year evaluation plans for the ministry's policy articles, without delegating rule-making power or shifting power away from parliament or courts.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management for the year 2020 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the other ministries, and advised submitting them to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, sent on 16 September 2019, states that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes not included in the text.

35570-IX.s: This bill fixes the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) in thousands of euros, and amends the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 to add a budget for the Nationaal Groeifonds with the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate responsible for its management. It is retroactive to 15 September 2020 for the Comptabiliteitswet change and takes effect from 1 January of the budget year.
35570-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the Nationaal Groeifonds budget with a 100% end-of-year margin and added purpose description to make the fund controllable by parliament and the Algemene Rekenkamer.
q: With the changes and the description in the NGF budget act it is clear to parliament what it can check the government on.
Door de wijzigingen en de omschrijving in de begrotingswet van het NGF is het voor het parlement duidelijk waarop het de regering kan controleren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against using the budget law to amend the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 to create the Nationaal Groeifonds as a non-departmental budget, and recommended a separate founding statute for a budget fund with a statutory purpose definition and clarity on overlap with existing schemes. The minister's reply (nader rapport) states that one non-blank advice concerns the Finance budget and is addressed in an annex, with other budget changes proposed, but the body of the reply does not specify how each point was answered.
concerns: Using the budget law to amend the CW 2016 is inconsistent with the constitutional character of budget laws, and the Afdeling advises deleting article 4 of the Begrotingswet Financiën.

The Nationaal Groeifonds should be established as a budget fund by a separate founding statute under article 2.11 CW 2016, with the statutory safeguards for budget funds, including the year-end surplus rule.
The fund lacks a statutory definition of the purposes for which its money may be spent, risking misallocation and weakening parliamentary control, so a clear purpose and demarcation are required.

The relationship and demarcation between the new fund and existing investment schemes such as the Infrastructuurfonds, Toekomstfonds, WBSO and Invest-NL is unclear, and the fund's fiscal risks are not explained.

35899.s: This bill approves the royal decree of 16 August 2021 that extends for a third time the period of validity of most provisions of the Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act (Twm), as required by Article VIII of that Act. The extension of three months is justified by the continuing threat of the epidemic, while the curfew basis and information-gathering provisions are allowed to lapse.
35899.j: The memorandum justifies the three-month extension by the continuing direct threat of the epidemic, which may require new measures if new virus variants emerge.
q: The government considers a three-month extension necessary because in the autumn there is still a direct threat of the covid-19 epidemic, as a result of which (new) measures to avert that threat may be necessary.

De regering acht verlenging met drie maanden noodzakelijk, omdat er in het najaar nog steeds sprake is van een directe dreiging van de epidemie van covid-19 waardoor (nieuwe) maatregelen ter afwending van die dreiging noodzakelijk kunnen zijn.

parties: Supports the extension as necessary but wants clarity on long-term measures and a debate with the government on future pandemic tools so the Twm is not repeatedly extended.
They do support the extension, because it is unfortunately still necessary given the uncertainty about the coronavirus in the autumn.
Zij steunen overigens de verlenging, omdat het helaas nog steeds noodzakelijk is gelet op de onzekerheid over het coronavirus in het najaar.
Questions whether the Twm's legal basis and restrictions remain proportionate and necessary for vaccinated people whose fundamental rights should be limited as little as possible.
These members therefore ask whether the legal basis of the measures in the Twm still applies to vaccinated persons.
Deze leden vragen derhalve of de juridische grond van de maatregelen in de Twm nog wel van toepassing zijn voor gevaccineerden.
Asks how long the temporary law is still needed and why the promised amendment of the Wpg, urged by a motion, has been delayed, so emergency procedures can end.
Why has the implementation of this motion been delayed for so long?
Waarom laat de uitvoering van deze motie zo lang op zich wachten?
Asks for concrete signal values for ending the measures, questions the basis of coronatoegangsbewijzen in the Wpg rather than a separate law, and objects to unequal treatment of events.
These members ask whether the government can share with the House at which signal values the Twm would, in their view, end, and at which signal values it should come back into force.

Genoemde leden vragen of de regering met de Kamer kan delen bij welke signaalwaarden de Twm wat hen betreft afloopt en in een dergelijk geval, bij welke signaalwaarden de Twm weer van kracht zou moeten worden.

Agrees with dropping the avondklok but criticises limited parliamentary control of the extension, the lack of renewed Council of State advice, and the broad use of coronatoegangsbewijzen and proportionality of youth activities.

Argues that the changed policy (coronatoegangsbewijs replacing the 1.5m rule, leaving most provisions unused) warrants renewed Council of State advice, and questions the effectiveness and criteria for the measures.
These members believe there are indeed changed circumstances at present which justify further advice from the Council of State.
Genoemde leden menen dat er op dit moment wel degelijk sprake is van gewijzigde omstandigheden waardoor een nader advies van de Raad van State gerechtvaardigd is.

35975-X.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence through a second supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and commitment amounts across policy and non-policy articles. It increases funding for veterans' compensation via the Nationaal Fonds Ereschuld and reallocates surpluses for border control and anti-crime tasks.
35975-X.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need to pay more veterans' compensation and by additional COVID-19-related and border-control costs, with the Cabinet providing extra funds.
q: Therefore the Cabinet has made an additional €30 million available in 2021 and the budget has been permanently increased by €20 million.
Daarom is door het Kabinet € 30 miljoen aanvullend beschikbaar gesteld in 2021 en is de begroting met € 20 miljoen structureel verhoogd.

35989.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, as a first incidental supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures, adjusting appropriations in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 10 December 2021 and makes no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding state attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

35998.s: The bill amends the Visserijwet 1963 to give the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality power to impose administrative fines for violations of fisheries rules, and amends the Wet op de economische delicten accordingly. Fine categories and amounts are to be set by general administrative measure and ministerial regulation, with a statutory maximum tied to the Criminal Code.
35998.j: The memorandum justifies the new fining power by the need for quick, effective lik-op-stuk enforcement and EU Commission guidance, and justifies delegating fine categories by the large number of violations and frequent changes.
q: To promote compliance with fisheries regulations, the Visserijwet 1963 and the Economic Offences Act provide for both administrative and criminal enforcement.
Om de naleving van de visserijregelgeving te bevorderen, is in de Visserijwet 1963 en de Wet op de economische delicten voorzien in zowel bestuursrechtelijke als strafrechtelijke handhaving.
d: fine categories and amount setting for administrative fines
assignment of specific violations to fine categories
p: Gives the Minister power to impose punitive administrative fines outside criminal procedure, with fine amounts left largely to lower regulation and a statutory cap linked to the Criminal Code maximum.

parties: Asks for clarity on the agreements between the Public Prosecution Service and the NVWA on which offences are handled administratively, on court jurisdiction over fines, and on the legal basis for data exchange and workload.
Can the government confirm that these agreements will be laid down in public agreements, so that it is clear to everyone how which offences are dealt with?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat deze afspraken zullen landen in openbare afspraken, zodat voor iedereen duidelijk is op welke manier welke overtredingen worden afgedaan?
Supports strengthening enforcement but asks where the threshold lies between administrative and criminal enforcement and what consequences this has for alleged offenders.
They are curious, however, when the tipping point occurs from administrative to criminal enforcement.
Wel zijn zij benieuwd wanneer het omslagpunt plaatsvindt van bestuursrechtelijke handhaving naar strafrechtelijke handhaving.
Asks what aggravating circumstances justify criminal prosecution, how that is decided, and why the sector was not consulted beforehand.
They ask the government to explain which aggravating circumstances may justify criminal prosecution and how it will be decided.
Zij vragen de regering toe te lichten welke verzwarende omstandigheden reden kunnen zijn voor strafrechtelijke vervolging en op welke wijze hierover besloten zal worden.

Fears serious violations will be settled with administrative fines rather than prosecution, citing weak control capacity and calculating behaviour; asks for a prior review procedure and for criteria on fine levels.
According to the Partij voor de Dieren members, one must at all times guard against settling cases of serious violations with an administrative fine.
Er moet volgens de leden van de Partij voor de Dieren-fractie te allen tijde worden gewaakt voor het met een bestuurlijke boete afdoen van gevallen van ernstige overtredingen.

Asks how the most protective legal route for fishers is guaranteed and how disproportionate responses to honest mistakes are prevented, and how legal equality is ensured when offence types are changed by ministerial regulation.
They further ask how the government will prevent disproportionate responses to honest mistakes.
Verder vragen zij hoe de regering gaat voorkomen dat er buitenproportioneel gereageerd wordt op oprechte vergissingen.

Accepts the aim but worries that complex, hard-to-know rules clash with strict enforcement; asks whether suspensive effect during objection and appeal was considered and how the distinction between natural and legal persons is handled.
The SGP members would like to know whether the government, given the complexity of fisheries regulations, considered granting suspensive effect to the objection and/or appeal stage.

De leden van de SGP-fractie horen graag of de regering gelet op de complexiteit van de regelgeving voor de visserij heeft overwogen om aan de fase van bezwaar en/of beroep opschortende werking toe te kennen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised deleting a notification-of-non-prosecution provision from the Visserijwet 1963 bill as redundant with the Wetboek van Strafvordering, and objected to delegating setting of fine amounts to the minister by ministerial regulation. The government followed the first advice, deleted the provision, and rejected the second, explaining that only categories and amounts in the AMvB and specific classification in the ministerial regulation would be set.
concerns: The notification-of-non-prosecution provision duplicates the Wetboek van Strafvordering and should be deleted; the government deleted it.

Setting fine amounts by ministerial regulation is an essential element that should not be delegated to the minister; the government rejected this and kept the subdelegation, citing the large number of frequently changing violations.

36200-XII.s: The bill sets the 2023 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the budget statements for its executive agencies (Rijkswaterstaat and KNMI), in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum excerpts describe policy plans, budgets and ILT supervisory activities but contain no new delegated rule-making or power shifts in the bill itself.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement for the year 2023 attached to this law is hereby adopted.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State had no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport merely forwards technical amendments in appendices and confirms the timing of submission, without responding to any substantive objections.

36470-IX.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget statement (IXA) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue across policy articles. The explanatory memorandum sets out materiality thresholds for explaining budget changes and explains changes to the financial markets article, without delegating rule-making power.

36560-IX.s: This bill (Slotwet 2023) amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget statement (IXA) to reflect final outturns, setting out revised commitments, expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We have deemed and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2023 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd

36625-IV.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) in thousands of euros, reducing expenditure on article 1 (strengthening the rule of law) and article 4 (socioeconomic structure) and reallocating funds within the ministry. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Amendment of the 2024 budget statements of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES-fonds (H)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en het BES-fonds (H) voor het jaar 2024

36740-IX.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statements (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), recording the final realised figures against the adopted and supplementary budgets. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendments effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36799.s: The bill amends the Wet structuur uitvoeringsorganisatie werk en inkomen to let UWV, the SVB and municipalities engage in proactive service delivery, including researching potential beneficiaries and contacting them to inform or help them apply for benefits. It also allows data processing for this purpose, with delegated rules set by general administrative order (AMvB) and an opt-out right, while excluding use of such data for enforcement.
36799.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the appropriate rules depend on local circumstances and that detailed rules should be fixed at AMvB level to protect privacy and legal certainty.
q: The bill makes it possible for citizens to invoke the opt-out.
Het wetsvoorstel maakt mogelijk dat burgers een beroep kunnen doen op de opt-out.
d: rules on cooperation and single desk for proactive service delivery
data provision, benefits covered, retention periods and security measures for proactive service
inter-agency data sharing to test necessity of data for proactive service
procedure for opt-out objections and registration of objections
content and submission of annual plan and budget of UWV and SVB
rules on annual reports and interim reports of UWV and SVB
p: Gives UWV, SVB and municipalities a discretionary power to contact potential beneficiaries and process their data before any application, intruding on privacy.
Allows further processing of administrative data across agencies, including municipal data outside the SUWI domain, to screen individuals for benefit eligibility.[...]
Prohibits using data obtained for proactive service for enforcement, a safeguard limiting executive use of the data.

parties: Asks whether citizens will be protected from repayments caused by pre-filled data and automatic awards for which they are not responsible.

Can the government guarantee that citizens can rely on the fact that, when data have been pre-filled by the government and their income has not changed, they will not later face corrections or reclaims?

Kan de regering waarborgen dat burgers erop kunnen vertrouwen dat, wanneer gegevens vooraf door de overheid zijn ingevuld en hun inkomen niet is gewijzigd, zij niet achteraf worden geconfronteerd met correcties of terugvorderingen?
Worried that the discretionary power lets each SUWI partner, notably municipalities, implement the law differently, deepening existing inequality in income support.

These members ask whether the government can explain to what extent the Wet proactieve dienstverlening SZW reinforces these differences between municipalities, because each SUWI partner can give its own interpretation to the law.

Deze leden vragen of de regering toe kan lichten in hoeverre de Wet proactieve dienstverlening SZW deze verschillen tussen gemeenten versterkt doordat de SUWI-partijen elk zelfstandig invulling kunnen geven aan de wet.
Asks how the discretionary power will be applied generically, what regulation will follow in the AMvB, and how citizens are informed of their right to refuse data sharing via the opt-out.
They ask the government to what extent effect is given to the right of citizens to know which information is shared with whom.
Zij vragen de regering in hoeverre er invulling wordt gegeven aan dat burgers het recht hebben om te weten welke informatie met wie wordt gedeeld.
Argues a central opt-out register would better protect citizens' privacy and asks why a fragmented approach per SUWI partner was chosen.
These members therefore ask the government to justify why the bill chose a fragmented approach per SUWI partner, instead of this more efficient and citizen-friendly solution.

Deze leden vragen de regering daarom te motiveren waarom er in het wetsvoorstel is gekozen voor een versnipperde aanpak per SUWI-partij, in plaats van voor deze efficiëntere en burgervriendelijkere oplossing.
Asks whether implementing bodies' limited capacity and added administrative pressure could undermine the benefits and other services.
In addition, these members ask whether there is a risk that other forms of service by the implementing organisations will suffer from the increased administrative pressure this bill entails.

Daarnaast vragen deze leden of er een risico bestaat dat andere vormen van dienstverlening door de uitvoeringsorganisaties zullen lijden onder de toegenomen administratieve druk die dit wetsvoorstel met zich meebrengt.
Asks how unequal treatment and prejudice in case-by-case discretion are prevented, and why no opt-out exists for the residual category whose data are retained.
How is it prevented that large differences in treatment per case arise and that prejudices come into play, as the Labour Inspectorate also indicates?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat er grote verschillen in behandeling per casus worden ontweken en er geen vooroordelen mee gaan wegen, zoals ook de Arbeidsinspectie aangeeft?
Asks why data exchange between SUWI partners needs a stronger legal basis and compares with Belgium's automatic use of authentic sources.
The SGP members ask the government to explain further why exchanging data between SUWI partners cannot suffice with a legal basis as is the case when a SUWI partner uses its own data.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering nader toe te lichten waarom voor het uitwisselen van gegevens tussen SUWI-partijen niet volstaan kan worden met een basis in de wet zoals het geval is met het gebruiken van de eigen gegevens door een SUWI-partij.

Agrees with the Council of State that the discretionary power limits effectiveness, finds large differences between SUWI partners undesirable, and asks why a more binding legal framework was not chosen.
The ChristenUnie members consider overly large differences very undesirable.
Al te grote verschillen achten de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie zeer onwenselijk.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advises on the Wet proactieve dienstverlening SZW, which gives UWV, SVB and municipalities a discretionary power to proactively contact potential beneficiaries to reduce non-take-up of benefits. The Afdeling raises concerns about effectiveness given dependence on capacity and data availability, unequal treatment across bodies, the legal basis for processing health data, the relation between two opt-out routes, and the ban on using shared data for enforcement; the government reply largely accepts these points and commits to amending the explanatory memorandum and monitoring.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness of the discretionary approach given reliance on implementing capacity and limited data, and asks for justification in the explanatory memorandum, which was added.
Data limitations (missing income and tax data, non-reach of non-clients) restrict targeted proactive service; government acknowledges and plans monitoring and possible expansion via amendment.
Processing of health data requires a sound legal basis under the GDPR; the government justifies it under several Article 9(2) exceptions and adds safeguards to the memorandum.
Clarification needed on how the two opt-out routes relate; the government confirms controllers must point out the opt-out at first contact per Article 21 GDPR.
The ban on using data for enforcement should also cover data exchanged between SUWI parties; the government clarifies the article-level explanation.
Unequal treatment across bodies must be avoided and justified differences explained in the explanatory memorandum, which was supplemented.

36850-IV.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), mainly reallocating funds within Koninkrijksrelaties and adding small amounts. It sets the budgets in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2025.
q: Amendment of the 2025 budget statements of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES Fund (H).
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en het BES-fonds (H) voor het jaar 2025.

36850-VI.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the 2025 budgets of its agencies through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles such as police, legal aid, prisons and counterterrorism. It also sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 December 2025.
36850-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by an autonomous increase in demand for Juridisch Loket services and an expected underspending on legal aid, without any new executive powers.
q: The budgetary framework of the Juridisch Loket is supplemented by EUR 10.3 million because an autonomous increase in demand for the Juridisch Loket's services is visible.
Het budgettaire kader van het Juridisch Loket wordt aangevuld met € 10,3 mln., omdat er een autonome toename te zien is in de vraag naar de dienstverlening van het Juridisch Loket

36889.s: The bill amends the Archiefwet 1995 to allow archive custodians to make archival records containing special or criminal personal data available to requesters with a personal interest, and to make open-access archives available online to the public. It also permits the Minister to designate restricted-access records containing personal data for internet publication by ministerial decision, subject to safeguards, consultation and delegation to a general administrative order.
36889.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the strong public interest in access to war and totalitarian-era archives and by the need for legal certainty, while stressing privacy safeguards and deferring detailed balancing rules to a general administrative order.
q: Making archival records containing (special or criminal) personal data available online is a far-reaching power that can infringe on personal privacy.

Het via internet beschikbaar stellen van archiefbescheiden die (bijzondere of strafrechtelijke) persoonsgegevens bevatten, is een ingrijpende bevoegdheid die inbreuk kan maken op de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
d: designation of restricted records for internet publication
balancing rules and conditions for lifting access restrictions
balancing rules and safeguards for online availability of archives
additional safeguard measures for online publication
p: Gives the Minister power to designate restricted records containing personal data for online publication, with statutory criteria, a balancing test and public internet consultation as safeguards.
Artikel I, C and D (art. 15, art. 17)
Expands archivists' and custodians' discretion to grant access to records with special personal data and attach conditions, subject to balancing rules set in a general administrative order.

parties: Asks for stronger supervisory powers for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and asks how broadly the government reads 'overheidsarchief' and whether private-life harm to victims and acquitted suspects is safeguarded.

Existing supervisors, such as the Dutch Data Protection Authority, deserve more powers, expertise and resources to check algorithms and systems for transparency, explainability, proportionality and discrimination.

Bestaande toezichthouders, zoals de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, verdienen meer bevoegdheden, expertise en middelen om algoritmen en systemen te controleren op transparantie, uitlegbaarheid, proportionaliteit en discriminatie.

Questions whether leaving the balancing of fundamental rights to lower regulation (AMvBs and Besluit) is adequate and asks whether these are part of the plenary debate; also asks about the 'waarborgen' versus 'maatregelen' wording and whether the scope exceeds the AVG.
these members find it a legitimate question whether the chosen approach, leaving those balancing decisions to lower regulation, is sufficient.
vinden deze leden de vraag legitiem of de gekozen vorm, het maken van die afwegingen, te beleggen bij lagere regelgeving voldoende is.
Has no questions for the government.
These members have no questions for the government.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen aan de regering.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division broadly endorsed the bill amending the Archiefwet 1995 to allow processing of special and criminal personal data for online-restricted archives (notably the Central Archive for Special Jurisdiction), but advised narrowing its scope to the events named in GDPR recital 158, adding time elapsed as an explicit balancing criterion, and clarifying safeguards in law. The minister's reply reports that the scope was narrowed (adding war archives), time elapsed was added, and general safeguards were written into the bill, while leaving detailed balancing rules to lower-level regulation.
concerns: The Council advised limiting the scope of online publication of restricted archives to the events named in GDPR recital 158, since the bill's scope was broader than the title suggested; the government narrowed it but added war archives generally.
The Council advised legally fixing the passage of time as a separate criterion in the balancing of interests; the government added it to the bill.

The Council raised the primacy of the legislator and asked whether the safeguards and balancing criteria for access by persons with personal interests should be set in the statute itself rather than lower regulation; the government declined to change the bill on this point.
The Council noted a discrepancy between the bill's title referring to GDPR recital 158 and its broader content; the title was amended accordingly.

36898.s: The bill modernises the Dutch sanctions framework, replacing much of the Sanctiewet 1977 with a new Wet internationale sanctiemaatregelen that sets out implementing rules, reporting duties, supervision and enforcement, and registry annotations. It lets ministers and designated bodies issue ministerial regulations, appoint trustees to take over companies or frozen registered property, and in some cases overrule ordinary management of those companies.
36898.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for speed and flexibility as the EU sanctions regime changes quickly, and the trustee powers by the public interest in avoiding serious social and employment harm.
q: The effectiveness of sanctions measures can only be guaranteed if the legislation is sufficiently equipped to apply to a constantly changing sanctions landscape.
De effectiviteit van sanctiemaatregelen kan alleen gewaarborgd worden als de wetgeving voldoende uitgerust is om toepassing te geven aan een steeds veranderend sanctielandschap.
d: implementing rules for UN/EU binding sanctions, by AMvB or ministerial regulation
implementing rules for recommendations and international arrangements
immediate interim rules pending an AMvB
manner and content of reporting duties
designation of supervisors by ministerial decision
designation of additional enforcement bodies by sanctions decree or regulation
fine amounts per violation category set in sanctions decree or regulation
rules on processing personal data for recommendations and arrangements
p: The minister may appoint a trustee with power to give binding instructions to a Dutch company and, where needed, to replace its board, on the minister's own initiative and without a court order.
The minister may appoint a person to replace a company's board or management where sanctions are seriously breached or evaded, with costs charged to the company.
The minister may take over management of frozen registered property, such as real estate, vessels and aircraft, from its owner and bar the owner from management acts.
Administrative enforcement tools including orders, administrative fines and enforced compliance are added alongside criminal sanctions.
The Chamber of Commerce may annotate public registers when sanctions apply to a registered party.
The minister may collect data from many public registers and authorities, including intelligence-related notifications and notary deeds, to investigate company ownership.

parties: Asks whether enforcing bodies such as Customs are equipped to carry out the expanded enforcement, and how overlap between criminal and administrative enforcement is avoided.
Asks whether UN General Assembly resolutions and ICJ advisory opinions can ground sanctions under the legal basis retained from the 1977 Act.
The members ask the government whether recommendations from UN General Assembly resolutions or ICJ advisory opinions fall under this heading.

De leden vragen de regering of aanbevelingen uit resoluties van de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties (AVVN) of advisory opinions van het Internationaal Gerechtshof (IGH) onder deze noemer vallen.
Wants new powers to be targeted, enforceable and legally sound, and asks how proportionality and subsidiarity are tested for the special enforcement power.
The CDA members ask whether the government can explain how proportionality and subsidiarity are tested in practice for this special power.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten hoe proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit in de praktijk worden getoetst bij deze bijzondere bevoegdheid?

Criticises the bill's enforceability, legal certainty, proportionality, data-protection gaps and the open-ended delegations, and asks how citizens can foresee coverage and what legal protection applies to register annotations.
The BBB members ask how it is ensured that citizens and businesses can foresee in advance when they fall under the law, and how arbitrariness and unequal application are prevented.

De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen de regering hoe wordt geborgd dat burgers en bedrijven vooraf kunnen voorzien wanneer zij onder de reikwijdte van de wet vallen, en hoe wordt voorkomen dat dit leidt tot rechtsongelijkheid en willekeur in de toepassing.

Supports strong sanctions but wants a workable climate for businesses, asks how ne bis in idem is protected between administrative and criminal routes, and asks about trustee expertise and speed of decisions.
Asks the government to reflect on the effectiveness of sanctions and the tension between consistent neutral application and their political nature.
The ChristenUnie members also ask the government to reflect on the tension between the wish for sanctions to be applied as consistently and neutrally as possible and their political nature.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering ook te reflecteren op de spanning die kan bestaan tussen enerzijds de wens dat sanctiemaatregelen zo consequent en neutraal mogelijk worden ingezet

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises on the draft Wet internationale sanctiemaatregelen, supporting its aims but raising serious doubts about the ministerial power to appoint a bewindvoerder over companies, plus concerns on data-sharing grounds, delegation to lower regulation for authorities and residence permits, and asks for adaptations. The government's nader rapport accepts several points (adds representation powers, drops the on-request bewindvoerder, adds a residence-permit provision, adds a reference to a future bill) while rejecting others (no separate bill for data-sharing and data-processing grounds, rejecting the bill-follow-up for authorities).
concerns: Doubts about the effectiveness of the ministerial power to appoint a bewindvoerder over companies, which the government answered by adding powers to represent and replace management while keeping the instrument.

The bewindvoerder is the only available measure rather than a graduated set of proportionate measures, and the government partly responded by adding representation and management-replacement powers only where needed.
Concern about the bewindvoerder's publication in the Staatscourant and market-sensitive information, which the government reviewed and maintained publication.
Advice to clarify how the enquiry procedure before the Ondernemingskamer relates to the bewindvoerder, which the government addressed in an expanded explanation.
Advice to commit in the bill to a follow-up bill whenever the generic data-sharing ground of article 8.2.5 is used, which the government rejected because of conflicting EU law.

Advice to require a follow-up bill when lower regulation designates additional administrative bodies with enforcement powers, which the government partly followed by adding a temporary delegation provision.

Advice on the generic data-processing ground under article 10 of the Constitution and the lack of essential elements in lower regulation, which the government largely did not adopt beyond clarifying the explanation.
Concern about the removal of article 4 Sanctiewet 1977 and its effect on legal protection against residence-permit withdrawal, which the government restored in a new article 2.3.1.
